title: documentation-alignment-summary-schema-20260728
rawUserRequest: RFE-ISSUE-118：全面整改计划要求每个 Work Item 在 Summary 中记录结构化 documentationAlignment，但当前 Summary 校验器会把该字段判为 unknown。请按“指示—计划—实现—验收”双向追踪机制修复，完整走完独立 Contract、测试、质量、归档、PR、Hosted CI、合并、ai-close-work-item 和分支清理流程；流程问题继续记录，计划全部完成后统一确认。

declaredIntent.summary: Make per-Work-Item documentation alignment a required, source-bound, bidirectionally traceable Summary record without rewriting historical archives.

outOfScope: Rewriting archived Summary evidence to backfill the new field
Treating documentation alignment as proof of runtime capability, provider controls, or enterprise compliance
Weakening changed-file, scope, instruction-traceability, or archive validation
Resuming the paused deep-performance Work Item in this corrective
Changing release identity, release workflows, candidate versions, tags, or publication state

sources.reason: Section five requires every Work Item to record documentationAlignment and RFE-ISSUE-118 records the schema contradiction.
The canonical Summary validator currently rejects documentationAlignment because it is not an allowed or validated field.
New Work Item Summary skeletons must expose the required alignment record before implementation.
Installed and upgraded adopter repositories receive independently generated Summary skeletons that must remain schema-compatible.
Lifecycle closure must rewrite documentation-alignment evidence from active artifact paths to their archived locations without mutating immutable execution evidence.
The closed RFE-117 predecessor recorded RFE-ISSUE-118 and supplies the serial lifecycle evidence for this corrective.

riskAssessment.reason: Making the field optional would preserve the omission; making it retroactively mandatory for immutable archives would break history. The validator must require complete alignment evidence for current V2 Work Items while retaining explicit legacy-archive compatibility.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized the bidirectional traceability mechanism and continuous execution of corrective Work Items without another confirmation.

preReviewWarnings: Confirm every new active V2 Summary must contain all five documentation-alignment domains before finish.
Confirm historical archived Summaries remain readable without mutation or backfill.
Confirm evidence paths are repository-relative, exist, and are declared in changedFiles or sourcesUsed.
Confirm changed documentation/command surfaces are reverse-mapped into documentationAlignment evidence.
Confirm starter, installer, example, validator, documentation, and tests use one shape.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A1: Current contractVersion 2 Summaries require documentationAlignment with schemaVersion, root status, checkedAt, and exactly five named alignment domains.

A2: Finish fails closed unless root status is aligned and every domain is aligned or explicitly not_applicable with a concrete reason; not_checked, misaligned, missing, duplicate, or unknown domains are rejected.

A3: Every aligned evidence entry is a non-empty repository-relative path that exists and is declared by Summary changedFiles or sourcesUsed; machine-specific paths, URLs, missing files, and undeclared evidence fail closed.
A4: Every changed documentation or command surface is reverse-mapped into documentationAlignment evidence so a named README, guide, Makefile, or template command file cannot be silently omitted.
A5: Existing archived Summaries without documentationAlignment remain readable through explicit legacy-archive compatibility and are never rewritten.

A6: ai-start, adopter install/upgrade generators, and the checked Summary example initialize the same not_checked skeleton; bounded installer finalization deterministically closes its own final write set before Finish, and archive transition rewrites alignment evidence to durable archived paths.

A7: Field semantics, lifecycle timing, limitations, and archive compatibility appear in the authoritative lifecycle references, and RFE-ISSUE-118 is bidirectionally traced from instruction to plan, implementation, negative tests, and acceptance.
A8: This corrective completes checkpoints, full quality, archive, PR, Hosted CI, merge, ai-close-work-item, branch deletion, and synchronized main before the performance Work Item resumes.
guidelines: Use one canonical documentationAlignment validator for active, finish, archive, and PR Summary checks.
Alignment evidence reports repository facts; it must not become a second capability or verification truth source.
Require bidirectional declaration between alignment evidence and changedFiles or sourcesUsed.
Preserve immutable historical archives through explicit compatibility rather than backfill.
Keep starter, installer, example, documentation, and tests structurally synchronized.

intent.problem: The execution plan requires every Work Item to confirm that plans, canonical evidence, documentation/commands/capability claims, multilingual semantics, and limitations/history remain aligned. The current Summary schema has no documentationAlignment field and rejects attempts to record it. As a result, collaborators can perform the check only in prose scattered across other fields, so the required evidence is neither mechanically complete nor resistant to omission.
constraints: Do not weaken unknown-field rejection or accept unstructured prose.
Do not rewrite immutable archived Summaries.
Do not allow URLs, absolute paths, missing paths, or undeclared paths to masquerade as repository alignment evidence.
Do not infer implemented capability from documentation alignment.
Keep the schema usable by template-maintenance and adopter-generated Work Items.
Do not resume performance work or modify release state in this corrective.
intent.rationale: A fixed five-domain record with reverse path binding makes the plan's close-out requirement executable. Requiring it for current V2 Work Items prevents future omission, while an explicit legacy-archive exception preserves historical evidence integrity.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A new Work Item reaches finish with all five documentation-alignment domains and source-bound evidence.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The canonical Summary validator accepts the aligned record and the lifecycle can continue.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a focused positive fixture with all domains, repository-relative declared evidence, and an offset-aware checkedAt timestamp.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A Summary omits documentationAlignment or leaves any required domain not_checked, misaligned, duplicated, or absent.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The Summary gate reports the exact missing or incomplete invariant and finish remains blocked.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add parameterized negative tests for root status and required-domain completeness.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Alignment evidence is an absolute path, URL, missing path, or a path not declared by changedFiles or sourcesUsed.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The Summary gate rejects the evidence with a distinct path or declaration diagnostic.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use temporary repository fixtures and parameterized invalid evidence values.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A README, documentation file, Makefile, or installed command template changes without appearing in alignment evidence.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Reverse mapping fails closed and identifies the omitted documentation/command surface.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Patch changedFiles fixtures with representative surfaces and prove each must be cited by the appropriate alignment record.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A historical archived Summary predating the new field is validated without mutation.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Legacy archive mode accepts the absent field while current active V2 mode rejects it.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Extend archive compatibility tests with the same Summary under legacy and active validation modes.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Template and adopter workflows generate a new Summary skeleton.
scenarioCoverage.expected: ai-start, installation/upgrade output, and the checked example expose an identical five-domain not_checked shape; archive transition preserves durable alignment references.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Extend start, installer, finish, archive, and contract-example tests to compare the initial shape, prove installer finalization aligns its declared write set before Finish, and prove active artifact references are rewritten on archive.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.
